headline: Renames a VA outpatient clinic in Gilbert, Arizona, after Staff Sergeant Alexander W. Conrad.
what_it_does: This law officially names the Department of Veterans Affairs community-based outpatient clinic at 3285 South Val Vista Drive in Gilbert, Arizona, as the Staff Sergeant Alexander W. Conrad Veterans Affairs Health Care Clinic. It changes the clinic's official name but does not change its services, staffing, or hours. The summary does not describe any other changes.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on January 5, 2021, and the renaming took effect on that date.
